brief.question: Build a desktop painting colour assistant: open an image, crop it, view a greyscale value study with N levels, a colour-reduced version with N levels, overlay a composition grid (rule of thirds, Fibonacci spiral, square grid), and for each reduced colour compute a Kubelka-Munk mixing recipe from a user-defined pigment palette (watercolor / acrylic / oil, with transparency per paint).
brief.purpose: Tool for an artist planning a painting; no original program to match, built from the request alone.
brief.done_when: cargo build succeeds, screenshot shows the workspace with a sample image, self-test passes move/act/hud, palettes can be created and saved, recipes shown per colour.

plan.title: Set up the project and the paint-mixing maths
Palette manager: create palettes with named paints, pigment codes and transparency
Image workspace: open, crop, greyscale value levels, colour levels
Composition overlays: rule of thirds, Fibonacci spiral, grid
Mixing recipes for each colour of the picture and for any clicked spot
Build, take a screenshot, run the self-test and fix what fails
plan.why: rebuild_check: build, screenshot, self-test passed; mechanics behaviour unverifiable
